ValidationRule.description: Certain opp product fields are required when the stage changes to Verbal Commit.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
ISCHANGED(StageName) && OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Verbal Commit"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") )
&& Products_with_Discount_Required__c != Products_With_Discount_Fields__c
&& RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Partner" && RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Expansion_Upsell"
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please make sure that all opportunity products (other than Benefits Enrollment, Scale, and Contractor) have the following fields filled in: Discount Type, Discount Duration, Discount %, Billing Currency
